      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts</link>
      <description><p>Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts</p><p>The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.</p><p>The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party.       <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/friday-briefing-after-a-week-of-disruption-is-living-with-threats-our-new-normal</link>
      <description><p>In today’s newsletter: From diverted airliners to hacked ​fridges, a string of disruptive incidents has exposed the ​vulnerabilities of modern ​life. ​There is now an increasingly blurred space between peace and conflict, the grey zone.</p><p>Good morning. A multiplicity of hoax bomb threats divert passenger flights across Europe. A malign cyber-attack targets supermarket fridges in Belgium, Sweden, the UK and – in a sickening escalation – the cold storage facilities of France’s national blood service.</p><p>The actors behind this week of chaos and disruption, be they hostile states or criminal gangs – or even enterprising teenagers – are yet to be identified.       <description><p>Unusual instance of three states administering the death penalty on the same day previously happened in 2010</p><p>Alabama, Florida and Indiana all carried out executions on Thursday in an unusual instance of three states administering the death penalty on the same day.</p><p>In a record-tying 19th execution of the year, Florida executed Jesse Guardado via a three-drug lethal injection. Guardado had pleaded guilty to fatally stabbing a 75-year-old woman inside her Walton county home in 2004 before stealing her jewelry box, $80 and other valuables to buy drugs.       <title>Fox News suffers ratings drop on bleak election night for Republicans</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/media/2026/nov/04/fox-news-midterm-ratings</link>
      <description><p>News channel trailed NBC and ABC, but edged out CNN, MS Now and CBS in primetime hours on midterm election night</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/community/live/2026/nov/05/what-happens-after-the-blue-wave-our-reporters-answer-your-midterm-election-results-questions">Q&amp;A: Ask your questions about Democrats’ win in the midterms</a></p></li></ul><p>On a midterm election night that was a huge disappointment for <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/republicans">Republicans</a>, with <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/democrats">Democrats</a> taking control of the US House and Senate, the country’s most prominent conservative television network seemingly felt the brunt of viewer disillusionment with <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/donaldtrump">Donald Trump</a> and his party, according to final audience numbers released on Thursday.</p><p>The Fox News channel, which often leads among all news networks in viewership on election nights, fell behind two top broadcasters on Tuesday. According to ratings dating from the Nielsen firm, the network averaged 4.3 million total viewers between 8 and 11pm, behind broadcast networks NBC (6.7 million viewers) and ABC (5.2 million viewers), though it edged out fellow cable networks CNN (4.1 million viewers) and MS Now (3.7 million viewers). Fox News handedly defeat CBS News, which attracted just 2.8 million viewers. CNN performed better in the 25-to-54 age demographic prized by advertisers, besting Fox News, MS Now and CBS.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/media/2026/nov/04/fox-news-midterm-ratings">Continue reading...</a></description>
